reserveReview.rationale: The June 30, 2026 certification reconciles 968,789 outstanding wMXN across seven chains to MXN2,086,193.01 in a Mexican bank account and certifies full local-currency backing. Pablo Eduardo Soto signed the certification on July 28, 2026 for SLD y Asociados S.A. The engagement expressly does not constitute an audit or review and expresses no professional opinion. The bank and account terms remain undisclosed, and the collateral surplus is unexplained. The official wFIAT attestation index serves this report as its latest wMXN evidence on September 30, 2026; the 92-day-old balance date remains outside the live adapter's 33-day freshness ceiling.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The latest report on the official attestation index as checked on 2026-10-01 is the June 30, 2026 certification, signed July 28, 2026 by Pablo Eduardo Soto for SLD y Asociados S.A. It reconciles 968,789 outstanding wMXN across seven chains to MXN 2,086,193.01 deposited in a Mexican bank account. The engagement expressly does not constitute an audit or review and expresses no professional opinion; procedures use client-supplied documents. The bank is not named, and the report does not establish account segregation, insolvency protections, rehypothecation terms, successor custody, or an explanation for the collateral surplus. The June balance date is not re-dated to the retrieval date.
